title: MALWARE ANALYSIS＆REVERSE ENGINEERING
description: Hands-on analysis of malware. How hackers package and hide malware and viruses to evade analysis. Disassemblers, debuggers, and other tools for reverse engineering. Deep study of Windows Internals and x86 assembly.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: COMS W3157 AND CSEE W3827 ; or equivalent.
